title: Variables atomic batch op — create/update/delete/reorder in one watermarked request (POST /design/variables/batch, 10-rest-api.md §4.4)
_comment: WP-Q01 design fixture. Carries the EXACT variables batch request body (10-rest-api.md §4.4) in `settings` (the only free-form object slot in the locked envelope, 14-fixtures-harness.md §2). Encoded invariants: (1) `watermark` is REQUIRED (the optimistic-concurrency token) — a stale watermark fails the whole batch → WATERMARK_STALE (12-error-taxonomy.md §3.3). (2) `operations[].type` ∈ create|update|delete|restore|reorder (rest-api.php:507). (3) all three variable types are FREE: global-color-variable, global-font-variable, global-size-variable. (4) limits: id ≤ 64, label ≤ 50, value ≤ 512, ≤ MAX 1000 variables; over-budget → BUDGET_EXCEEDED. (5) `op_id` for idempotent replay. expect.valid:true is the STRUCTURAL validity of the batch body (kind:design fixtures are NOT run through Validator::dry_run; the design-write suite asserts the body against §4.4). The 'reorder' op carries the final order array consistent with the surviving ids after create+delete.
